methodology: Documented TEDCO-administered funding subtotal: largest reported cumulative portfolio amount plus individually dated later investments; otherwise unique dated investments. Where MSCRF grants and investment portfolio coverage may overlap, the larger documented subtotal is used rather than summing them. Repeated equal-amount announcements within a calendar year are conservatively counted once. Repeated equal-amount MSCRF awards for the same disease target across reports are counted once; distinct disease targets are separate grants. Includes legacy Maryland Venture Fund investments. Unknown funding is unranked, never zero. This is an incomplete public-record subtotal, not certified lifetime funding or verified cash received. Company total capital raised and acquisition prices are excluded. Status reflects primary evidence on the cited source date; unknown is not defunct.
